title: Using the Blackwell-Cover Guessing Strategy to Separate Unobserved Bernoulli Trials
summary: Blackwell and Cover both proposed the same method for guessing the larger of a pair of two numbers when one can only observe one and the other of the two numbers remains unobserved. As originally stated, the procedure ended with a computation showing that the probability of correctly guessing the larger number was greater than one-half. In this paper, we investigate what we can say when about the number in the pair that was not observed we employ the Blackwell/Cover procedure. Let α1 and α2 be two different numbers in (0,1].
